evidence.label: Content Signals
evidence.detail: WARN: robots.txt has no Content-Signal declaration. Fix: Add a Content-Signal line to robots.txt (for example `Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no`) to state how AI systems may use your content.

evidence.label: Real 404 Pages
evidence.detail: FAIL: A missing page returns HTTP 200 (a soft 404). Fix: Return HTTP 404 for pages that don't exist. A 200 "soft 404" makes agents treat an error page as content.

evidence.label: Markdown via Accept Header
evidence.detail: FAIL: No sampled page serves markdown when asked with `Accept: text/markdown` (1 page checked). Fix: Return a markdown version of each page when a request sends `Accept: text/markdown`, with `Vary: Accept` so caches keep the two apart.

evidence.label: Markdown at .md URLs
evidence.detail: FAIL: No sampled page serves markdown at a `.md` URL (1 page checked). Fix: Serve each page's markdown at the same path with `.md` appended (and `/index.md` for the homepage).

evidence.label: llms.txt
evidence.detail: WARN: /llms.txt exists but has no markdown link lists. Fix: Publish /llms.txt as described at llmstxt.org: an H1 with the site name, a `>` summary, and sections of annotated markdown links.

evidence.label: Discovery Link Headers
evidence.detail: WARN: The homepage sends no discovery Link header. Fix: Add an HTTP Link header (RFC 8288) to the homepage pointing at your sitemap, llms.txt (`rel="describedby"`), and markdown alternate.

evidence.label: Organization Structured Data
evidence.detail: WARN: Organization JSON-LD is missing description. Fix: Add Organization JSON-LD to the homepage with name, url, logo, description, and contactPoint or address.

evidence.label: Page Structured Data
evidence.detail: FAIL: Sampled pages have no content-level structured data. Fix: Mark up pages with the schema.org type that fits them: Article or BlogPosting, Product or SoftwareApplication, FAQPage, HowTo, BreadcrumbList.

evidence.label: Content Freshness
evidence.detail: WARN: None of the sampled pages says when it was published or updated. Fix: State when each page was published and last updated: `datePublished` and `dateModified` in JSON-LD (or `article:modified_time`), and keep them accurate. Answer engi

evidence.label: About, Contact, and Privacy Pages
evidence.detail: FAIL: about isn't linked, contact isn't linked, and privacy isn't linked. Fix: Link About, Contact, and Privacy pages from the homepage. Agents use them to judge who is behind a site.

evidence.label: Document Structure
evidence.detail: WARN: 1 of 1 pages have structure issues (skipped heading levels). Fix: Wrap the main content in `<main>`, use one H1 per page, and don't skip heading levels.

headline: Elmich scores 71/100, but missing trust links and page schema hinder AI quoting.

findings.title: Missing About, Contact, and Privacy links
findings.why: The homepage omits links to About, Contact, and Privacy pages, making site ownership harder to verify.
findings.fix: Link About, Contact, and Privacy pages directly from the homepage.

findings.title: No content-level structured data on pages
findings.why: Sampled pages lack content-level schema, and Organization JSON-LD is missing a description.
findings.fix: Add Product or content schema.org markup to pages and a description to Organization JSON-LD.

findings.title: Missing pages return soft 404s
findings.why: Missing pages return HTTP 200, causing AI agents to treat error pages as real content.
findings.fix: Return HTTP 404 for nonexistent URLs instead of HTTP 200.

findings.title: No markdown support or complete AI discovery files
findings.why: Pages do not serve markdown, Link headers are missing, and llms.txt lacks markdown link lists.
findings.fix: Serve markdown at .md URLs and via Accept headers, add Link headers, and add links to llms.txt.

findings.title: No publication or update dates
findings.why: Sampled pages do not state when they were published or last updated.
findings.fix: Add accurate datePublished and dateModified values in JSON-LD on each page.

strengths.title: Solid 71/100 audit score with readable homepage content and 5 pages crawled
Site-wide JSON-LD types, visible prices, and contact details present
robots.txt and llms.txt exist, and 100% of 292 controls have accessible names
